falsification_conditions.condition: The ETF closes at least 2% above its 20‑day high on any trading day within the next 14 calendar days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive bullish breakout would contradict the current UNKNOWN/HOLD stance, indicating the engine should have issued a bullish signal instead.

falsification_conditions.condition: The ETF’s price falls at least 2% below its 20‑day low on a day when that day’s volume is ≥ 3× the 30‑day average volume, occurring within the next 14 calendar days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A strong bearish breakdown with unusually high volume would invalidate the HOLD call, showing the engine should have signaled a bearish outlook.

falsification_conditions.condition: The Federal Reserve announces an unexpected interest‑rate cut of 25 basis points or more within the next 14 calendar days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A macro‑policy shift of this magnitude would materially alter market dynamics, making the current UNKNOWN/HOLD verdict obsolete and indicating a clear directional bias.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
